dailyBudget.note: Baseline historical estimate plus successful fresh census timings and configured pacing. Excludes retry overhead. No timings from the MARS production-client diagnostic are used. These branch totals exclude sibling PR additions.

audit.note: Valid native VIN sets include all parsed claims, including rejected claims, and are conservative supersets of accepted inventory. Intersections bound possible duplicate losses rather than assert accepted duplicate counts.

retryPolicy.limitation: Exhausted chunk transport retries end the source attempt; the next source attempt starts fresh. There is no durable page-level cooldown for network failures, and the two-hour source delay is measured from the preceding start.
